speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Flexor Tendinosis with Acute Inflammation (Jersey Finger).

Based on your account of the finger catching in a jersey during football and the subsequent swelling and pain, I suspect you may have avulsed or torn a tendon at the base of the finger. Can you try to bend your middle phalanx (the middle joint) of the right ring finger right now? If it won't move or feels unstable, we need to order an MRI immediately to assess the tendon integrity.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Right Hand (Flexor Digitorum Profundus).

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
